items.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
items.description: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

items.title: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
items.description: Experts say the hack could leave agents vulnerable to scams, blackmail and targeted attacks.

items.title: Pope warns against 'losing humanity' to AI machines
items.description: The pontiff delivered the warning on the first day of his trip to France on Friday.

items.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial database to check voter citizenship
items.description: Critics have questioned the reliability of the data, warning it could result in US citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.

items.title: Trump's plans for massive arch move ahead
items.description: Opposition to building the 250-foot arch, and using it for military purposes, is growing with one Democrat blasting Trump's plans as "foolhardy".

items.title: Students strike across Germany in protest against military service
items.description: A law establishing voluntary military service came into effect in January, but protest organisers fear compulsory service could follow.

items.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler dies
items.description: A gunman shot Jim Copenhaver twice while also killing another man and grazing Trump's ear with a bullet.

items.title: Xi got Trump's red carpet welcome - but not everything he wanted
items.description: China wanted progress on trade, technology and Taiwan - but hasn't got as much as it would have hoped for.

items.title: Senior Kazakh officials detained after 14 service members swept out to sea
items.description: Seventeen service members were swept out to the Caspian Sea during military exercises.

items.title: Jay-Z rape accuser says her allegation was false
items.description: A woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her when she was 13 now says she has never met the rap superstar.

items.title: Internet restricted after fighting breaks out in Ethiopia's Tigray region
items.description: During the two-year civil war in Tigray, the region was totally cut off from the outside world.

items.title: US backs Elon Musk's bid to overturn €120m EU fine against X
items.description: The EU had said X "deceives users" by selling blue ticks without "meaningfully verifying" accounts.

items.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
items.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

items.title: Africa's richest man helps fund $660m fuel pipeline between Ethiopia and Djibouti
items.description: The pipeline would strengthen energy security in landlocked Ethiopia, while creating jobs at Djibouti's port.

items.title: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
items.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the measures as "common-sense tools that do not divide but really help to integrate".

items.title: Media outlets banned by Trump resume White House coverage after judge's order
items.description: US TV news coverage of the White House returns to normal after a judge lifted Trump's ban of three news outlets.

items.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
items.description: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

items.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
items.description: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.

items.title: Rapper Macklemore announces 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran fallout
items.description: Proceeds from the tour, which begins in Dublin next month, will go to organisations supporting Palestinians, he says.

items.title: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
items.description: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.
